kind: Review-authored conceptual diagrams; no source artwork copied

evidence_steps.layout: Parallel questions, not an assay ranking or observed lineage

methods: carbon-14 dating of neuronal DNA with population turnover modeling

questions.limit: Molecular state does not itself establish cell birth, lineage or functional recovery

limits: DCX or PSA-NCAM alone does not date cell birth
Ki67 alone does not establish neuronal fate
RNA velocity and pseudotime infer state relationships rather than directly tracking lineage or elapsed time
birth, survival, differentiation, integration and functional benefit require distinct evidence

recovery_mechanisms.anatomy_scope: Containment diagram only, not an MRI, anatomical cross-section, scale drawing or estimate of relative sizes
limits: Dentate-gyrus findings are not generalized to all injured brain regions
Improved task performance alone does not identify a cellular mechanism

research_roles.layout: Four parallel roles from distinct studies and validation targets; no shared causal or treatment pipeline

future_question.ko: 같은 재활 조건에서 지속적인 기능 이득을 더하는가?
future_question.en: Under matched rehabilitation conditions, does it add lasting functional benefit?

en.body:
Classify graft projections from expression
Design injury-targeted expression switches
en.scope:
Mouse brain / spinal injury models
Human functional recovery untested

roles.validation_target: Molecular identity/projection relationships and injury-targeted expression; distinct mouse studies, not demonstrated human recovery

source_scope.Wang: Final abstract and institutional report; detailed public bioRxiv v2 methods, not final publisher full text. Human-derived graft cells in mouse ischemic cortex; expression/projection classification, not a human trial.
source_scope.Zamboni: Final full text. Injury-responsive enhancers tested in mouse spinal/cortical injury models; reporter cargo, not a functional recovery treatment.

roles.validation_target: Brain magnetic activity during walking in healthy participants; not neuron-birth measurement or patient rehabilitation efficacy
roles.source_scope: Spedden 2025: three healthy men performing single steps in a shielded room; not free everyday walking, cell-birth imaging or a patient efficacy trial. Borna 2023 supports the atomic-spin sensing mechanism.

Proposals / development plans

roles.validation_target: Research plans for quantum molecular calculations; not clinical evidence of human brain regeneration
roles.source_scope: Official research programme and quantum-testbed task. Molecular properties and hybrid workflows are proposed research tasks; no QPU-induced regeneration or rehabilitation effect is claimed.

limits: Distinct species, cohorts and endpoints are explicit; roles are not stages executed in one study
No efficacy percentages, common performance axis or cross-role arrows
The last question is prospective clinical validation, not an observed benefit
